title: Text Sanitization and Normalization
description: Standardization of raw free-text fields, removal of control characters, and Unicode normalization.
conditions: User input fields, comments, notes, or web-scraped strings
Presence of non-printable ASCII, Unicode accents, or HTML entity escapes
Downstream NLP or search indexing planned
recommended_methods: Unicode normalization form NFKD followed by ASCII encoding
Regex-based stripping of control characters (\x00-\x1f) and redundant whitespace
selection_rules: Always strip leading and trailing whitespace from every string feature
If text contains multilingual names, preserve UTF-8 rather than stripping accents to ASCII
If text contains embedded code or JSON strings, do not strip quotes or backslashes
limitations: Aggressive regex cleaning can destroy meaningful clinical syntax (e.g., '> 10 mg/dL')
Case folding loses distinction for acronyms (e.g., 'AIDS' vs 'aids')
